title: Find and rank AI opportunities
summary: AI is useful for some problems and wasteful for others. Find where it could help with your core challenge, and rank the opportunities by value, feasibility and risk.

beginner: List the tasks and decisions in your product or organisation that are slow, repetitive or data-heavy.
For each, ask whether AI could genuinely help.
Score each one for value, feasibility and risk.
Pick the top two or three to explore.
Check each one against your organisation's AI rules.
intermediate: Check data availability and quality for each opportunity.
Estimate running cost as well as build cost.
Plan small experiments to test the top opportunities.
experienced: Build an AI opportunity portfolio across products.
Balance quick wins with deeper bets.
Link AI opportunities to the strategy's core challenge.

toolExamples.miro: Plot opportunities on a value and feasibility grid.
toolExamples.claude: Use an AI assistant to brainstorm use cases, then check them with experts.

pitfalls: Using AI because it is fashionable
